title: Looking to make a player made shop in my game

posts.author: tsurugikage
posts.body:
I am trying to make a game where when the player is not battling monsters,  or saving the world,  they are running their shop to get as much money as possible.
Something similar to Recettear: An Item Shop's Tale or Atelier Totori
Are there any plug-ins that are available for this, or is this possible in vanilla RPG Maker MZ?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Totally eventable. Also not heard of any plugins for that (MZ uses plugins, not scripts)
You can check out final profit on steam, they're doing that too.
